name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: A breadcrumb trail whose items slide in one after another. Marks the last item as the current page.

props.name: items
props.description: The trail in order: { label, href? }. The last item is the current page.

props.name: separator
props.description: Custom separator between items. Defaults to a chevron.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds each item takes to slide in. Items are staggered. 0 skips the entrance.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the nav element.
